settings.enableLocalHint: When off, the whole software runs in English. Nothing is deleted.

settings.saveFailed: Could not save the language settings.

branch.blockBelowCostHint: On, the tiles sales invoice refuses a line whose rate is below the purchase price listed in the product search. Off, a loss sale is written like any other line — for a clearance, or stock the market has moved under.
branch.reSaleToAdvanceHint: On, a new unit sale credits Advance against Unit Sale (a liability) instead of Sales, so the price becomes income only at handover. Sales already saved keep the head they were saved with. Off is the historical behaviour: the sale is income on the day it is made.
branch.reCostToWipHint: On, every Project Purchase, Project Expense and Project Labour voucher saved from now on also moves its project cost to Construction WIP (an asset), so building costs wait on the Balance Sheet until handover instead of reducing profit. The cost lines and project cost reports stay as they are. Vouchers saved earlier move only when they are edited and saved again.
branch.payrollIntro: How Salary Generate works out this branch's salaries.
branch.salaryEngineHint: On, Salary Generate pays each employee from their salary revision, one column per pay head (Basic, Mobile Bill, Lunch Bill...). Off, the old fixed sheet. Saved at once; switch it off to go back.
branch.wageSplitHint: On, an employee's salary takes one gross wage and splits it: the fixed allowances come off, Basic is the rest divided by the divisor, House Rent is a share of Basic. Saved with Update.
